# GDP per Capita (2026) - IMF

*   Source:[IMF, World Economic Outlook (April 2026)](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/weo/issues/2026/04/14/world-economic-outlook-april-2026).Data Type:**Projections for 2026** in **Nominal** terms.
*   **GDP per Capita** represents the total monetary value of all goods and services produced within a country over one year, **divided by its population**.
*   **Nominal** (or "Current") GDP reflects current prices and exchange rates, without adjustments for inflation or cost-of-living differences.
*   See also: [GDP by Country](https://www.worldometers.info/gdp/gdp-by-country/)

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is GDP per capita?

GDP per capita is calculated by dividing the total Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of a country by its population. It expresses the average economic output, often used as a rough proxy for average income, per person in the country. The population number used is the average (or mid-year) population for the same year as the GDP figure.

What is the difference between nominal and PPP GDP per capita?

Nominal GDP per capita uses current market prices and exchange rates to convert all values into US dollars, without any adjustment for price differences between countries. PPP (Purchasing Power Parity) GDP per capita adjusts for differences in the cost of goods and services across countries, expressed in "international dollars." PPP is generally considered a better measure for comparing living standards, since a dollar buys more in some countries than in others.

What is the world average GDP per capita?

The world average GDP per capita (PPP) is around $25,000 as of 2024. This is a population-weighted average, calculated by dividing total global output (adjusted for purchasing power) by the world's population.

# GDP per Capita (2026) - IMF

*   Source:[IMF, World Economic Outlook (April 2026)](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/weo/issues/2026/04/14/world-economic-outlook-april-2026).Data Type:**Projections for 2026** in **Nominal** terms.
*   **GDP per Capita** represents the total monetary value of all goods and services produced within a country over one year, **divided by its population**.
*   **Nominal** (or "Current") GDP reflects current prices and exchange rates, without adjustments for inflation or cost-of-living differences.
*   See also: [GDP by Country](https://www.worldometers.info/gdp/gdp-by-country/)

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is GDP per capita?

GDP per capita is calculated by dividing the total Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of a country by its population. It expresses the average economic output, often used as a rough proxy for average income, per person in the country. The population number used is the average (or mid-year) population for the same year as the GDP figure.

What is the difference between nominal and PPP GDP per capita?

Nominal GDP per capita uses current market prices and exchange rates to convert all values into US dollars, without any adjustment for price differences between countries. PPP (Purchasing Power Parity) GDP per capita adjusts for differences in the cost of goods and services across countries, expressed in "international dollars." PPP is generally considered a better measure for comparing living standards, since a dollar buys more in some countries than in others.

What is the world average GDP per capita?

The world average GDP per capita (PPP) is around $25,000 as of 2024. This is a population-weighted average, calculated by dividing total global output (adjusted for purchasing power) by the world's population.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is GDP per capita?

GDP per capita is calculated by dividing the total Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of a country by its population. It expresses the average economic output, often used as a rough proxy for average income, per person in the country. The population number used is the average (or mid-year) population for the same year as the GDP figure.

What is the difference between nominal and PPP GDP per capita?

Nominal GDP per capita uses current market prices and exchange rates to convert all values into US dollars, without any adjustment for price differences between countries. PPP (Purchasing Power Parity) GDP per capita adjusts for differences in the cost of goods and services across countries, expressed in "international dollars." PPP is generally considered a better measure for comparing living standards, since a dollar buys more in some countries than in others.

What is the world average GDP per capita?

The world average GDP per capita (PPP) is around $25,000 as of 2024. This is a population-weighted average, calculated by dividing total global output (adjusted for purchasing power) by the world's population.

Those bordering Russia are: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Finland? Actually Finland borders Russia by land. Also maybe EU member Latvia and Estonia belong to EU and border. Also maybe Finland. Also currently EU includes Malta, Cyprus etc but no border.

So exclude Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Finland. Also maybe EU member 'Russia' not a member. So consider others 23 countries.

Now need GDP per capita 2023. IMF WEO 2023 data. Use IMF DataMapper. Might need to fetch particular page for each country.

We have query results for Ireland, Austria etc.

Let's gather GDP per capita for all 23 EU countries. We may need to compile manually using IMF data if accessible.

Alternatively we could use worldometers site or Wikipedia list for GDP per capita 2023.

The worldometer link https://www.worldometers.info/gdp/gdp-per-capita/ shows data list.

Let's fetch that.
